Proposition
[Positivity of the Density]

↗ def:density-pointwise

If $(v_1,\ldots ,v_n)$ is linearly independent, then $|v_1\wedge \cdots \wedge v_n|>0$.

Proof

↗ def:density-pointwise \sketch The Gram matrix is positive definite on a linearly independent family, hence has positive determinant; its defining square root is therefore positive.

□
